svg.title: YouTube and TikTok monetization ladder
svg.desc: Current monetization milestones for YouTube and TikTok, with a note that rules change by country.
svg.text: Checked November 2026. Programs, countries and thresholds can change. Verify in the platform dashboard.

g.text: 500 subscribers + 3 public uploads in 90 days + 3,000 watch hours/12 months OR 3M Shorts views/90 days.
1,000 subscribers + 4,000 watch hours/12 months OR 10M Shorts views/90 days.
From Feb 1, 2027 for new YPP creators
1,000 subscribers + 8,000 watch hours/12 months OR 20M Shorts views/90 days.
From Feb 1, 2027: 10M qualified Shorts views per 90 days to earn from the Shorts Creator Pool that month.
Reviews often take about a month. Original content and policy compliance matter.
18+ · personal account in good standing · eligible country · 10,000 followers · 100,000 video views/30 days.
Original videos at least 1 minute long. 1,000 qualified For You views needed to start earning.
LIVE gifts, subscriptions, TikTok Shop and affiliate programs have separate eligibility by region.
Your own footage, animation, voice and edit. Reuploads, compilations and unedited third-party clips are not a safe path.
Check TikTok Studio for current country availability and program terms.

svg.text: Sources: YouTube Help “YouTube Partner Program overview & eligibility”, “YouTube Shorts monetization policies”, “Changes to the YouTube Partner Program”; TikTok Support “Creator Rewards Program”.
